The remaining intact probe change010:18 and all clean losses/match changes/empty output are covered by visual-adjudication.json. This is assistant visual review, not independent metrology or label revision.

supplemental_raw_proposal_review.scope: All clean gained/lost five- or ten-pixel pair identities and the four supporting covered-side ten-pixel gains were checked against the emitted proposals.
supplemental_raw_proposal_review.purpose: Distinguish changes in canonically selected predictions from accurate alternatives already emitted but left unmatched by confidence-ordered box association.
supplemental_raw_proposal_review.synthetic_supporting_gains: No already-successful PR35 alternative was found for the four supporting covered-side ten-pixel gains among display-eligible proposals meeting the fixed IoU 0.50 criterion.
supplemental_raw_proposal_review.interpretation: Alternative-proposal diagnostics use the frozen references after evaluation. They are explanatory checks, not a replacement scoring rule, an oracle selection policy or evidence of natural hidden-coordinate accuracy.
